name: subly
description: Subly — digital subscriptions marketplace for Pakistan (Next.js frontend + Node.js backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
